1	# kanban-s3 — Multi-user Kanban board service with web UI (tier S3)
2	
3	A Trello-style Kanban backend (JSON REST API over `node:http`, no frameworks) with authentication, roles, WIP limits, labels, comments, search, an activity log, file persistence, and a single-page web UI served at `/`.
4	
5	## Module
6	- `src/server.js`: `export function createServer({ dataFile } = {})` → a `node:http` `Server` (NOT yet listening). If `dataFile` is given, all data (users, boards, columns, cards, labels, comments, activity) is loaded from it on creation and saved to it after every mutation (synchronously or before the response is sent). A new server created with the same file sees the same data. Sessions/tokens need not survive restarts.
7	- `src/main.js`: starts the server on `process.env.PORT || 3000` with `dataFile = process.env.DATA_FILE || './data.json'`.
8	
9	## Conventions
10	- JSON request/response bodies (`Content-Type: application/json`). Invalid JSON → 400.
11	- Errors: status code + body `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<text>" }`. Codes used by tests: 400 validation, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not found (also unknown routes), 409 conflict, 429 rate limited.
12	- IDs are strings. Timestamps are ISO-8601 strings.
13	- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every `/api` route except register/login. Missing/invalid/logged-out token → 401.
14	- Passwords must be stored hashed with a salt (e.g. `crypto.scrypt`); the plaintext password must not appear in the data file.
15	
16	## Users / auth
17	- `POST /api/auth/register {username, password, displayName?}` → 201 `{ user }`. `username`: 3–32 chars of `[a-z0-9_]`, case-insensitive (stored lower-case), unique (409). `password` ≥ 8 chars (400). `displayName` defaults to the username.
18	- `POST /api/auth/login {username, password}` → 200 `{ token, user }`; wrong credentials → 401. After 5 failed attempts for one username within 15 minutes, further attempts (even correct) → 429.
19	- `POST /api/auth/logout` → 204 (token invalidated). `GET /api/auth/me` → 200 `{ user }`.
20	- User object: `{ id, username, displayName }` (never the password hash).
21	
22	## Boards and roles
23	Roles per board: `owner` (exactly one; the creator), `editor`, `viewer`.
24	viewer: read only. editor: may create/edit/move/delete columns, cards, labels and comments. owner: everything, plus board settings, members and deletion. A non-member gets 403 on board-scoped resources that exist; unknown ids → 404.
25	- `POST /api/boards {name, description?, columns?}` → 201 board. `name` 1–100 chars. `columns` (array of names) defaults to `["To Do", "In Progress", "Done"]`.
26	- `GET /api/boards` → `[{ id, name, role }]` for boards the user is a member of.
27	- `GET /api/boards/:id` → `{ id, name, description, ownerId, createdAt, members: [{ userId, username, role }], labels: [label], columns: [{ id, name, position, wipLimit, cards: [card sorted by position] }] }`, columns sorted by position.
28	- `PATCH /api/boards/:id {name?, description?}` (owner) → 200 board. `DELETE /api/boards/:id` (owner) → 204 (everything on it is deleted).
29	- `POST /api/boards/:id/members {username, role}` (owner; role `editor`|`viewer`) → 201 `{ userId, username, role }`; unknown user 404; already member 409.
30	- `PATCH /api/boards/:id/members/:userId {role}` (owner) → 200. `DELETE /api/boards/:id/members/:userId` (owner, or a member removing themself) → 204; removing the owner → 400.
31	
32	## Columns
33	- `POST /api/boards/:id/columns {name, wipLimit?}` → 201 column appended at the end. `wipLimit`: positive integer or null.
34	- `PATCH /api/columns/:id {name?, wipLimit?, position?}` → 200. Changing `position` (0-based, clamped to range) reorders the board's columns; positions stay contiguous `0..n-1`.
35	- `DELETE /api/columns/:id` → 204; if it still has cards → 409 unless `?force=true` (then its cards are deleted too). Remaining positions re-compacted.
36	
37	## Cards
38	Card: `{ id, boardId, columnId, title, description, position, assignees: [userId], labels: [labelId], dueDate, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt }`.
39	- `POST /api/columns/:id/cards {title, description?, assignees?, labels?, dueDate?, position?}` → 201. `title` 1–200 chars. `dueDate` `YYYY-MM-DD` or null. Assignees must be board members and labels must belong to the board (400). Default position: end of column; explicit position inserts and shifts others.
40	  If the column has a `wipLimit` and already holds that many cards → 409 with `error: "wip_limit"`.
41	- `GET /api/cards/:id`; `PATCH /api/cards/:id {title?, description?, assignees?, labels?, dueDate?}` → 200 (updates `updatedAt`); `DELETE /api/cards/:id` → 204.
42	- `POST /api/cards/:id/move {columnId, position?}` → 200 card. Target column must be on the same board (400). Moving into a different column respects its WIP limit (409 `wip_limit`). Positions in source and target columns remain contiguous `0..n-1`, ordered as the user requested.
43	
44	## Labels
45	- `POST /api/boards/:id/labels {name, color}` → 201 `{ id, boardId, name, color }`; `color` must be `#rrggbb` (400). Names unique per board, case-insensitive (409).
46	- `DELETE /api/labels/:id` → 204 and removed from every card.
47	
48	## Comments
49	- `POST /api/cards/:id/comments {body}` (editor+) → 201 `{ id, cardId, authorId, body, createdAt }`; `body` 1–5000 chars.
50	- `GET /api/cards/:id/comments` → oldest first.
51	- `DELETE /api/comments/:id` → 204; only the comment's author or the board owner (others 403).
52	
53	## Search
54	`GET /api/boards/:id/cards?q=&assignee=&label=&column=&due_before=` → array of matching cards (all filters ANDed; `q` is a case-insensitive substring of title or description; `assignee` a userId; `label` a labelId; `column` a columnId; `due_before` `YYYY-MM-DD`, exclusive, cards without due date excluded), sorted by column position then card position.
55	
56	## Activity log
57	`GET /api/boards/:id/activity?limit=` → newest first (`limit` default 50). Entry: `{ id, boardId, type, actorId, cardId?, at, details }`. Types that must be recorded: `board.created`, `column.created`, `card.created`, `card.updated`, `card.moved` (details include `fromColumnId`, `toColumnId`), `card.deleted`, `comment.added`, `member.added`.
58	
59	## Web UI
60	`GET /` serves a single-page HTML app (`Content-Type: text/html`) that lets a user register/log in, list and create boards, and view a board with its columns and cards, create cards and move them between columns (drag-and-drop or buttons), using the API above. Additional static assets may be served under `/static/`.

# kanban-s3 — Multi-user Kanban board service with web UI (tier S3)

A Trello-style Kanban backend (JSON REST API over `node:http`, no frameworks) with authentication, roles, WIP limits, labels, comments, search, an activity log, file persistence, and a single-page web UI served at `/`.

## Module
- `src/server.js`: `export function createServer({ dataFile } = {})` → a `node:http` `Server` (NOT yet listening). If `dataFile` is given, all data (users, boards, columns, cards, labels, comments, activity) is loaded from it on creation and saved to it after every mutation (synchronously or before the response is sent). A new server created with the same file sees the same data. Sessions/tokens need not survive restarts.
- `src/main.js`: starts the server on `process.env.PORT || 3000` with `dataFile = process.env.DATA_FILE || './data.json'`.

## Conventions
- JSON request/response bodies (`Content-Type: application/json`). Invalid JSON → 400.
- Errors: status code + body `{ "error": "<code>", "message": "<text>" }`. Codes used by tests: 400 validation, 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, 404 not found (also unknown routes), 409 conflict, 429 rate limited.
- IDs are strings. Timestamps are ISO-8601 strings.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every `/api` route except register/login. Missing/invalid/logged-out token → 401.
- Passwords must be stored hashed with a salt (e.g. `crypto.scrypt`); the plaintext password must not appear in the data file.

## Users / auth
- `POST /api/auth/register {username, password, displayName?}` → 201 `{ user }`. `username`: 3–32 chars of `[a-z0-9_]`, case-insensitive (stored lower-case), unique (409). `password` ≥ 8 chars (400). `displayName` defaults to the username.
- `POST /api/auth/login {username, password}` → 200 `{ token, user }`; wrong credentials → 401. After 5 failed attempts for one username within 15 minutes, further attempts (even correct) → 429.
- `POST /api/auth/logout` → 204 (token invalidated). `GET /api/auth/me` → 200 `{ user }`.
- User object: `{ id, username, displayName }` (never the password hash).

## Boards and roles
Roles per board: `owner` (exactly one; the creator), `editor`, `viewer`.
viewer: read only. editor: may create/edit/move/delete columns, cards, labels and comments. owner: everything, plus board settings, members and deletion. A non-member gets 403 on board-scoped resources that exist; unknown ids → 404.
- `POST /api/boards {name, description?, columns?}` → 201 board. `name` 1–100 chars. `columns` (array of names) defaults to `["To Do", "In Progress", "Done"]`.
- `GET /api/boards` → `[{ id, name, role }]` for boards the user is a member of.
- `GET /api/boards/:id` → `{ id, name, description, ownerId, createdAt, members: [{ userId, username, role }], labels: [label], columns: [{ id, name, position, wipLimit, cards: [card sorted by position] }] }`, columns sorted by position.
- `PATCH /api/boards/:id {name?, description?}` (owner) → 200 board. `DELETE /api/boards/:id` (owner) → 204 (everything on it is deleted).
- `POST /api/boards/:id/members {username, role}` (owner; role `editor`|`viewer`) → 201 `{ userId, username, role }`; unknown user 404; already member 409.
- `PATCH /api/boards/:id/members/:userId {role}` (owner) → 200. `DELETE /api/boards/:id/members/:userId` (owner, or a member removing themself) → 204; removing the owner → 400.

## Columns
- `POST /api/boards/:id/columns {name, wipLimit?}` → 201 column appended at the end. `wipLimit`: positive integer or null.
- `PATCH /api/columns/:id {name?, wipLimit?, position?}` → 200. Changing `position` (0-based, clamped to range) reorders the board's columns; positions stay contiguous `0..n-1`.
- `DELETE /api/columns/:id` → 204; if it still has cards → 409 unless `?force=true` (then its cards are deleted too). Remaining positions re-compacted.

## Cards
Card: `{ id, boardId, columnId, title, description, position, assignees: [userId], labels: [labelId], dueDate, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt }`.
- `POST /api/columns/:id/cards {title, description?, assignees?, labels?, dueDate?, position?}` → 201. `title` 1–200 chars. `dueDate` `YYYY-MM-DD` or null. Assignees must be board members and labels must belong to the board (400). Default position: end of column; explicit position inserts and shifts others.
  If the column has a `wipLimit` and already holds that many cards → 409 with `error: "wip_limit"`.
- `GET /api/cards/:id`; `PATCH /api/cards/:id {title?, description?, assignees?, labels?, dueDate?}` → 200 (updates `updatedAt`); `DELETE /api/cards/:id` → 204.
- `POST /api/cards/:id/move {columnId, position?}` → 200 card. Target column must be on the same board (400). Moving into a different column respects its WIP limit (409 `wip_limit`). Positions in source and target columns remain contiguous `0..n-1`, ordered as the user requested.

## Labels
- `POST /api/boards/:id/labels {name, color}` → 201 `{ id, boardId, name, color }`; `color` must be `#rrggbb` (400). Names unique per board, case-insensitive (409).
- `DELETE /api/labels/:id` → 204 and removed from every card.

## Comments
- `POST /api/cards/:id/comments {body}` (editor+) → 201 `{ id, cardId, authorId, body, createdAt }`; `body` 1–5000 chars.
- `GET /api/cards/:id/comments` → oldest first.
- `DELETE /api/comments/:id` → 204; only the comment's author or the board owner (others 403).

## Search
`GET /api/boards/:id/cards?q=&assignee=&label=&column=&due_before=` → array of matching cards (all filters ANDed; `q` is a case-insensitive substring of title or description; `assignee` a userId; `label` a labelId; `column` a columnId; `due_before` `YYYY-MM-DD`, exclusive, cards without due date excluded), sorted by column position then card position.

## Activity log
`GET /api/boards/:id/activity?limit=` → newest first (`limit` default 50). Entry: `{ id, boardId, type, actorId, cardId?, at, details }`. Types that must be recorded: `board.created`, `column.created`, `card.created`, `card.updated`, `card.moved` (details include `fromColumnId`, `toColumnId`), `card.deleted`, `comment.added`, `member.added`.

## Web UI
`GET /` serves a single-page HTML app (`Content-Type: text/html`) that lets a user register/log in, list and create boards, and view a board with its columns and cards, create cards and move them between columns (drag-and-drop or buttons), using the API above. Additional static assets may be served under `/static/`.

content.text:
I built the whole SPEC.md service, and `node --test` passes (2 tests: the public smoke test plus one I added).

The retrieve-or-write estimate was that writing it myself was cheaper. The spec is small and very specific, so finding and adapting existing code would have cost more. Nothing was retrieved or vendored. `PROVENANCE.json` is `[]`, and I didn't create `src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

- **`src/server.js`:** a `createServer({ dataFile })` using only `node:http`. It covers everything in the spec: auth (scrypt-hashed passwords, 429 after 5 failed logins in 15 minutes), boards with roles, columns with WIP limits, cards and moves, labels, comments, search, and the activity log. When `dataFile` is set, the data is saved to it after every mutation.
- **`src/main.js`:** starts the server on `PORT` (default 3000), saving to `DATA_FILE` (default `./data.json`).
- **`src/ui.js`:** the single-page UI served at `/`. It handles login and register, board list and create, board view, adding cards, and moving cards with buttons or drag-and-drop. I have not opened it in a browser, so the UI is untested.

My extra test covers card positions, a WIP-limit conflict on move, and the activity log. The rest of the spec has no tests of its own, so those parts are untested.

On auth failures I return 401 for a missing or invalid token before any 404 or 403. Permission checks come before body validation.
